reviewer: Codex native source, physical material measurement and actual mobile visual review

identity.evidence: Native complete sources and final six drawings compared with the canonical FA56 athlete: adult bald faceless pale anatomy model, smooth featureless pelvis, no shorts, original fine grey contours and white trainers (swimming is barefoot). No new athlete generation. All retained native athlete/grip RGB pixels are exact; no anatomical warping, individual limb fitting or head/shoe grafts.

camera.evidence: Fixed poolside camera, 1472x848; six complete native athletes receive only integer horizontal translations 20/52/88/124/160/196px. Real coping tile junctions, located independently by unique raw RGB patch matches in delivered frames, remain fixed. Tile width and coping depth remain invariant. The moving swimmer is not incorrectly treated as a fixed anchor.

anatomy.evidence: Six native stroke states inspected: continuous shoulder/elbow/wrist and hip/knee/ankle chains, long body line, alternating arms and small kicks; side-breath head turns with the torso. All exposed body regions are original intact drawings. No doubled or detached limbs; inherited minor illustrative contour differences are not calibrated anatomy.

equipment.evidence: Ordinary front-crawl pool setting with actual far coping material and tile joints. No added tether, harness or flume changes the catalogue exercise. Bare feet and hands stay free; no fabricated fitness equipment.

contact.evidence: Water-supported prone stroke; no planted-floor contacts are asserted. Body stays aligned across the stroke and partially submerged head turns to the side during Breathe. Fixed geometry uses genuine pool coping material. Forward travel is illustrative and is not a measured swimming speed or distance.

physics.evidence: Compared against primary Swim England front-crawl and breathing guidance: long body line, natural body roll, side inhalation, recovery/catch progression and small continuous kicks. Whole athlete moves forward past fixed coping. One six-state traversal stops at frame6; no automatic backwards jump to frame1. Not a continuous fluid simulation.

muscles.evidence: Existing primary #7B72E9 and secondary #9590E0 fields and inherited shading are preserved without a new gradient. Live legend agrees with the catalogue muscle groups. Neutral skin/contours and equipment remain neutral. No painted highlight crosses an occluded surface.

cueAgreement.evidence: Exact bound six labels/cues visually checked against their corresponding positions: Catch: Reach long and catch the water. / Pull: Pull under your body, elbow high. / Breathe: Turn with the body; breathe to the side. / Switch: Return face down; catch with the other arm. / Drive: Pull through; keep your hips high. / Enter: Enter fingertips first; kick small and steady. Preparation now specifies a long level body, side breathing, underwater exhalation and a small kick.
